sql: SELECT regexp_extract(r.abstractText, '([^.]*1,?630[^.]*)', 1) AS sentence FROM papers LATERAL VIEW explode(resultList.result) AS r WHERE r.pmid = '26920601' LIMIT 5
rows: The trial is planned to continue until at least 1,630 patients experience the secondary end point, thereby providing 90% power to detect a relative reduction of ≥15% in this end point
